# The cost of each build profile, checked against every run by
# scripts/ci-check-perf.
#
# FORMAT: metric  value  [tolerance%]. scripts/profile-costs writes the report
# and its header gives the metric keys. Each row is exact for a commit, so the
# 1% default is a significance threshold.
#
# When a number moves on purpose, update it in the same PR. The job summary
# prints the corrected lines. Keep the reason in the PR, not here.
